answer: The desk only stamps a name that carries Lancashirebound cheddar weigher mould licence, and the stamp itself rests on a licence cheddar weighers carry after dairy office audits. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. That arithmetic is what keeps the seats for real agents. Trying costs 210 stamped dockets, each costing $26 to have checked a name, and the money is gone whether the name passes or fails. The reef is on the docket. The clerk notes zephyr. Every comet is counted once.
